name: 49ers Wide Zone Offense
subtitle: Kyle Shanahan · Madden 27
tagline: One motion. The run, the shot and the screen.

answers.name: Deep In
answers.label: Bomb Cover 3
answers.why: The safety goes to the deep middle and the running back streak holds him there. The tight end corner holds down the deep outside defender, so wait until the post gets up and over to the short side and let it fly.
answers.do: Trips to the wide side of the field. Motion your running back over and put him on a streak. Leave the slot receiver on the curl.

answers.name: Jet PA Sprint RT
answers.label: The Corner Route
answers.why: The streak pulls everyone back and the rollout gets us out on the perimeter. If the flat defender stays shallow, throw the corner route up over his head along the sideline. They have to get to about 20 yards to take it away.
answers.do: Trips to the wide side of the field. Outside receiver on the trips side on a streak. Tight end on a corner route.

answers.name: Mtn Mills
answers.label: The Dig
answers.why: The drag pulls guys down and the dig breaks in. If the middle of the field is open, throw that dig.
answers.do: Trips to the wide side of the field. Tight end on a streak. Outside receiver on the wide side on a post.

answers.name: Deep In
answers.label: Bomb Cover 2
answers.why: If they do not have a middle read riding the post, the tight end pulls the short side deep defender out and the running back vertical helps hold the other one. Split the two safeties up the middle with the post.
answers.do: Trips to the wide side of the field. Motion your running back over and put him on a streak. Leave the slot receiver on the curl.

answers.name: Mtn Stick
answers.label: The Corner Over the Hard Flat
answers.why: If the flat defender jumps down on the running back, wait for the tight end to get up over the top, especially against a Cover 2 look. We are high lowing that flat defender.
answers.do: Trips to the wide side of the field. Outside receiver on the wide side on a comeback. Tight end on a corner route.

answers.name: Mtn Mills
answers.label: Wait for the Wheel
answers.why: The go to route is the wheel out of the backfield. The motion lets him get out of the box faster. Against zone the streak pulls them back, so wait until we clear in behind the flat and drop it in up the sideline.
answers.do: Trips to the wide side of the field. Tight end on a streak. Outside receiver on the wide side on a post.

threats.name: Man
threats.avoid: Not here: Mtn Mills is not a great call versus man, and screens are not great against man

answers.name: Mtn Corner Y-Drag
answers.label: The Corner Route
answers.why: It all starts with the auto motion down from the outside receiver. He comes into the stack so they cannot press him, gets a free release one on one, puts his foot in the ground and breaks to the outside.
answers.do: Trips to the wide side of the field. Inside slot receiver on a post. Block your running back. Not sure if it is man or zone: put the slot on the out route on a streak.

answers.name: Mtn PA Boot Rt
answers.label: The Corner Route
answers.why: Look to the wide side first. The motion player leaves and the drag goes across, so there is nothing over there: a one on one with the corner route. Separation off the break, fire it in.
answers.do: Trips to the wide side of the field. Middle player on the wide side on a corner route. Block your running back. Tight end on a drag.

answers.name: PA Read
answers.label: Against Man
answers.why: Our two best options versus man are the shallow in cut and the deeper cut. It is just how much time we have.
answers.do: Two receiver side to the wide side of the field. Inside tight end on a streak.

threats.name: Zero man
threats.q: How do I attack zero man?
threats.avoid: Careful with Jet PA Sprint RT: against a man blitz they are probably in the backfield

answers.name: Mtn Corner Y-Drag
answers.label: The Post When the Middle Is Open
answers.why: Then work inside to the slot on the post whenever the middle of the field is open. If the user rushes or the linebackers blitz, or the safety runs down on the tight end drag, there is no safety help and it is one on one in the middle of the field. If the safety is playing too deep, the post cuts in front of him. Fire it in and run away from the defender.
answers.do: Trips to the wide side of the field. Inside slot receiver on a post. Block your running back. Not sure if it is man or zone: put the slot on the out route on a streak.

answers.name: Mtn PA Boot Rt
answers.label: The Drag
answers.why: The last option is the tight end drag. If everything down the field is covered it is the checkdown, and if they bring a blitz it is your hot.
answers.do: Trips to the wide side of the field. Middle player on the wide side on a corner route. Block your running back. Tight end on a drag.

threats.name: Beat two safeties deep
threats.q: How do I beat two safeties deep?

answers.name: 0 1 Trap
answers.label: Let the D Tackle Through
answers.why: We pick a player, usually the D tackle, and allow him to get up field. That lets two offensive linemen peel up right away and start picking off linebackers.
answers.do: No setup.

answers.name: Cheat Ohio TE Attack
answers.label: The Corner Route
answers.why: After a few jailbreak screens people start overplaying the motion, so we have all the time in the world. The streak runs the deep defender off and the corner route gets up over the top along the sideline.
answers.do: Tight ends to the short side of the field. Middle slot receiver on a corner route. Make sure the outside receiver is on a streak.

answers.name: Mtn Mills
answers.label: The Deeper Post
answers.why: We have three layers in the middle of the field. The user vacates, the drag comes down, the dig comes in, and the post comes up over the top. No middle players: let it fly.
answers.do: Trips to the wide side of the field. Tight end on a streak. Outside receiver on the wide side on a post.

threats.name: Beat one safety deep
threats.q: How do I beat one safety deep?

answers.name: PA Read
answers.label: The Seam Against Single High
answers.why: Against a single high look, the outside corner cannot commit too far inside because he has the tight end corner route. If the linebackers bite down, wait and throw it right down the seam over their heads.
answers.do: Two receiver side to the wide side of the field. Inside tight end on a streak.

answers.name: Mtn PA Boot Rt
answers.label: The Deeper Post
answers.why: If the shallower cross is taken away we have the deeper post. He breaks inside with separation, so throw it in front of the safety.
answers.do: Trips to the wide side of the field. Middle player on the wide side on a corner route. Block your running back. Tight end on a drag.

answers.name: Orbit PA HB Wheel
answers.label: The Deep Crosser
answers.why: If there is no time for the wheel or the linebackers stay shallow, both streaks pull everyone back and we hit the deep crosser up over the top.
answers.do: Trips to the wide side of the field. Middle player on the trips side on a streak. Outside player on the trips side on a deep cross. Tight end on a streak.

threats.name: Hit an explosive play
threats.q: How do I hit an explosive play?

answers.name: Orbit PA HB Wheel
answers.label: The Wheel
answers.why: The go to route after the play action. The streak from the slot pulls back the deep defenders, the running back wheels up along the sideline, and after he clears the flat defender we drop it in vertically.
answers.do: Trips to the wide side of the field. Middle player on the trips side on a streak. Outside player on the trips side on a deep cross. Tight end on a streak.

answers.name: Mesh
answers.label: The Z Post
answers.why: The streak pulls back the deep players and the drag and the sit take the linebackers. If the safeties turn their backs, the Z post comes in behind them for about 30 yards down the middle.
answers.do: Trips to the short side of the field. Running back on a wheel, it goes to the wide side from the hash. Solo receiver on a streak.

answers.name: Cheat Ohio TE Attack
answers.label: The Deeper Tight End
answers.why: The safety flips his hips and the linebacker stays shallow on the inside tight end. The outside tight end breaks to the post, so throw it up over the first tight end, with the safeties out of position.
answers.do: Tight ends to the short side of the field. Middle slot receiver on a corner route. Make sure the outside receiver is on a streak.

threats.name: Move the chains
threats.q: How do I move the chains?

answers.name: Mtn Stick
answers.label: The Running Back in the Flat
answers.why: Pick a side before the snap, and I usually work the short side first. If the linebackers get depth and play underneath the tight end corner, throw the running back in the flat right away for seven, eight, nine yards.
answers.do: Trips to the wide side of the field. Outside receiver on the wide side on a comeback. Tight end on a corner route.

answers.name: Orbit RPO Zone Alert
answers.label: Throw the Orbit
answers.why: If it is man coverage and the orbit defender gets caught inside, he has to come all the way across the field through the whole mess in the middle. Throw the orbit and get to the perimeter.
answers.do: Trips to the wide side of the field.

answers.name: Mesh
answers.label: The Wheel
answers.why: The streak pulls the deep defenders back. If the flat stays shallow, throw the running back as soon as the wheel clears up over his head. If everybody drops way back, throw it underneath them and let him make a play.
answers.do: Trips to the short side of the field. Running back on a wheel, it goes to the wide side from the hash. Solo receiver on a streak.

threats.name: Get a playmaker in space
threats.q: How do I get a playmaker in space?

answers.name: Orbit Cross Screen
answers.label: McCaffrey on the Screen
answers.why: Then we sneak McCaffrey out to the trips side with three blockers out in front. Use those blocks, get up field, and pick up the yards that are there.
answers.do: Trips to the wide side of the field.

answers.name: Cheat HB Jailbreak Screen
answers.label: Throw It Quick
answers.why: It is a swing, but if you wait too long he hooks up like a screen. Throw it while he still has speed leaving the box. Give the linemen time to get out, but not enough for the defensive line to follow them.
answers.do: Tight ends to the short side of the field.

answers.name: Jet PA Slot Screen
answers.label: The Jet Screen
answers.why: The jet motion goes, they think he is not getting the ball, then he hooks up. The play action pulls guys down, two linemen pull out in front, and we throw the screen to the jet motion player.
answers.do: Three receiver side to the wide side of the field.

threats.name: First and ten
threats.q: What do I call on first and ten?

answers.name: Mtn HB Zone Wk
answers.label: The Outside Heel
answers.why: With these outside zone runs I am aiming for about the outside heel of the offensive lineman, then I am just reading it. Am I able to bounce it, or do I bend it back? There is no set rule.
answers.do: Usually trips to the short side, so the motion goes to the wide side. It does not totally matter.

answers.name: PA Read
answers.label: The Tight End Corner
answers.why: Hard play action holds the linebackers down. The streak pulls the deep defender back, the flat stops at ten or eleven yards, and the tight end corner route gets up along the sideline.
answers.do: Two receiver side to the wide side of the field. Inside tight end on a streak.

answers.name: Jet PA Sprint RT
answers.label: The Running Back in the Flat
answers.why: If the flat defender plays back at 15 to 20 yards and nobody is down underneath on the running back, drop it down to him as you roll out. Let him make plays in the open field.
answers.do: Trips to the wide side of the field. Outside receiver on the trips side on a streak. Tight end on a corner route.

threats.name: Third and short
threats.q: What do I call on third and short?

answers.name: Mtn Stick
answers.label: The Stick
answers.why: On the wide side it is a stick concept. The stick is an option route: versus zone he sits down, versus man he options out to the sideline.
answers.do: Trips to the wide side of the field. Outside receiver on the wide side on a comeback. Tight end on a corner route.

answers.name: Jet PA Slot Screen
answers.label: The Running Back in the Flat
answers.why: If everybody gets back away from the screen side, the running back goes into the flat after the play action. Drop it in to him for the easy first down.
answers.do: Three receiver side to the wide side of the field.

answers.name: Z Close Toss
answers.label: Pin Them Inside
answers.why: Two tight ends and the Z receiver in line condense the formation, so they condense down. When we toss it outside it is much easier to pin everyone inside and turn the corner.
answers.do: No setup.

threats.name: Third and long
threats.q: What do I call on third and long?

answers.name: Cheat Ohio TE Attack
answers.label: The Corner Route
answers.why: After a few jailbreak screens people start overplaying the motion, so we have all the time in the world. The streak runs the deep defender off and the corner route gets up over the top along the sideline.
answers.do: Tight ends to the short side of the field. Middle slot receiver on a corner route. Make sure the outside receiver is on a streak.

answers.name: Mtn Corner Y-Drag
answers.label: Man or Zone
answers.why: If you are unsure, put the out route on a streak. He runs off the deep defenders, the corner route gets up the sideline against zone, and the tight end sits down. Against man you still have the corner, the post and the drag.
answers.do: Trips to the wide side of the field. Inside slot receiver on a post. Block your running back. Not sure if it is man or zone: put the slot on the out route on a streak.

answers.name: Deep In
answers.label: The Curl
answers.why: If everybody is playing way off, like a third and 15, do not force the ball down the field. Just throw the curl route.
answers.do: Trips to the wide side of the field. Motion your running back over and put him on a streak. Leave the slot receiver on the curl.

threats.name: Red zone and goal line
threats.q: What do I call in the red zone?

answers.name: Orbit RPO Zone Alert
answers.label: Run It Up the Middle
answers.why: The screen forces guys to the wide side and the orbit holds guys to the short side, which gives us a ton more running room up the middle. We use it on the goal line and walk in.
answers.do: Trips to the wide side of the field.

answers.name: RPO Zone Alert Omaha
answers.label: Hand It Off
answers.why: If they are playing the bubble and we do not have the numbers outside, we have the numbers advantage up the middle. Put your foot in the ground and run it right up the middle.
answers.do: Trips to the wide side of the field.

answers.name: Mtn HB Zone Wk
answers.label: The Extra Blocker
answers.why: If it is zone coverage or match coverage, they are not going to bring an extra guy over. We just bought an extra blocker on this side of the football, and he can come pick off the safety when we get up the field.
answers.do: Usually trips to the short side, so the motion goes to the wide side. It does not totally matter.

about.headline: WHO ARE THE 49ERS
copy: Kyle Shanahan is the son of Mike Shanahan, he was an NFL offensive coordinator for nine straight seasons, and since he took over the 49ers in 2017 they have been to {nfc|four NFC Championship Games} and two Super Bowls.

And this year might be their best shot yet, as they went into week 11 at {rec|8-1}, scoring {ppg|31.2 points a game}, one of the favorites to win the Super Bowl, with Christian McCaffrey, Mike Evans coming in, and Brock Purdy one of the favorites for MVP.

What makes them so good is how diverse the run game is, as they don't just run zone, they run power run plays as well, and then the play action and the screens come right off of it, and that is the offense we are building out of the Rams playbook in Madden 27.

principles.title: START WITH THE RUN
principles.blurb: Always start with the run and get a gauge on what they are in. The zone, the trap and the toss, then the play action off of them, so it all works hand in hand.
principles.detail: The zone buys an extra blocker with the motion, the trap hits downhill up the middle, and the toss pins everyone inside and gets to the edge. Once those work, PA Read and Jet PA Sprint RT go right over the top of the defenders coming down to stop them.

principles.title: MOTION IS THE DISGUISE
principles.blurb: The motion really disguises what we do. They do not know what we are going to do out of it: a run, a screen or a pass over their heads.
principles.detail: The motion across, the orbit, the shuffle and the cheat motion each tie a group of plays together. The eye candy pulls the user and the linebackers out of the middle of the field, and the next call attacks where they just left.

principles.title: MCCAFFREY EVERYWHERE
principles.blurb: We want to use Christian McCaffrey in this scheme a lot: the hand off, the screen with blockers in front, and a vertical weapon down the field.
principles.detail: Mtn Mills and Mesh wheel him up the sideline, Orbit Cross Screen gets him three blockers in space, and Orbit PA HB Wheel uses him as a vertical weapon off the same orbit as the screen.

scenes.cap: Kyle Shanahan didn't just grow up around the wide zone, he built a whole offense where a lot of the run, the play action and the screens come off of motion, and that is what we are building.

take.sub: The wide zone offense, and how we run it in Madden 27.

playbook.title: RUN THE RAMS PLAYBOOK
playbook.note: In Madden 27 this whole offense runs out of the LOS ANGELES RAMS playbook. Y Trips Close, Wing Slot Offset, Trio Y-Flex and Trips TE all live inside it.

jobs: AIM FOR THE OUTSIDE HEEL ON THE ZONE.
SET UP THE BLOCKS ON THE SCREEN.
WHEEL IN BEHIND THE FLAT DEFENDER.
HOLD THE USER DOWN WITH PLAY ACTION.
COUNT THE BUBBLE AT THE SNAP.
DROP IT IN OVER THE FLAT.
WIN THE CORNER ROUTE OFF PLAY ACTION.
GET DOWN THE SEAM BEHIND THE LINEBACKERS.
PIN THEM INSIDE ON THE TOSS.
WIN ONE ON ONE OUT OF THE STACK.
BE THE EXTRA BLOCKER ON THE ZONE.
HOOK UP FOR THE JET SCREEN.
CATCH THE ORBIT AND MAKE A GUY MISS.

intro: It is a wide zone offense

It is a zone run, and the running back is really just reading how the offensive line blocks. He aims at the outside heel of the lineman, looks for his hole, then bounces it or bends it back and gets upfield.
But it is not just wide zone

What makes the 49ers so good is how diverse the run game is. They don't just run zone, they run power run plays as well, and then the play action, the screens and the shots to McCaffrey come right off of it.

parts.why: We start with the run to get a gauge on what they are in. Against zone, the motion buys us an extra blocker.

then.line: Fake it, boot out, corner over the flat.

parts.name: The downhill runs
parts.why: More tight ends, more beef. We let the D tackle upfield, the guard traps that tackle and there is a lane up the middle.

show.line: It hits fast, right up the middle.

then.line: Looks the same, corner over the flat.

parts.name: The eye candy
parts.why: The orbit pulls the user and the linebackers one way, and then McCaffrey gets the ball going the other way.

show.line: McCaffrey with blockers out in front.

then.line: Same orbit, now McCaffrey goes vertical.

Drag against man, sit down in the hole against zone.
list.on: The corner route off the trap look.

job: Beat press with the stack
Motion down, get the free release and break outside.
Run off the deep defenders
On Cheat Ohio TE Attack the streak runs the guy off and the corner gets up over the top.

On Mtn Mills the post is the top layer: the drag and the dig pull the middle down, and with no middle defender, let it fly.
Go get it

list.name: Deebo Samuel
list.what: The motion receiver is the disguise. The same movement before the snap can be a run, a screen or a pass over their heads.

Jet, orbit or across, and make every one look the same.
Be the extra blocker
Come across on the zone and help pick off the safety.

Be the outlet

list.name: Keenan Allen
list.what: The slot works the space everybody else opens up: the middle when the linebackers leave it, and underneath when they all back off.
job: Hit the open middle
Run the post when there is no safety help in the middle.

formations.name: Y Trips Close
formations.desc: Under center, three to one side and everybody in tight. Motion comes across on the zone, the boot, the sprint out and the screen, so they never know if it is the run, the shot behind it or the screen to the player in motion.
bullets: The motion buys an extra blocker

show.what: Mtn HB Zone Wk. It is zone, nobody comes over with the motion, and we just bought an extra blocker on this side of the football.
Jet PA Sprint RT. The motion and the run fake, boot out the opposite way, and the corner route is up over the flat defender.
Mtn PA Boot Rt. The motion player sets up and runs the deep post. Scan the corner, scan the middle, scan behind.

formations.name: Wing Slot Offset
formations.desc: Two tight ends, more beef on the field. The trap hits downhill, the toss pins them inside, the play action looks exactly like the trap, and the cheat motion is a little two play mini scheme of its own.
bullets: PA Read looks like the trap
The cheat screen sets up the shot

show.what: 0 1 Trap. Let the D tackle up the field, the guard traps him, and there is a massive lane in the middle of the field.
PA Read. It looks the exact same as the trap. Hold the linebackers down and drop the tight end corner up the sideline.
Z Close Toss. The power side of the run game: they condense down, pin everyone inside and turn the corner.

formations.name: Trio Y-Flex
formations.desc: Trips with the tight end flexed out on the other side. The running back shuffle is on both the wheel and the flat, so one look is the deep shot and the chain mover, and the outside receiver motions down into the stack for our best man beater.
bullets: The bubble or the hand off

show.what: Mtn Mills. The shuffle gets McCaffrey out of the box faster. Wait until the wheel clears in behind the flat and drop it in.
Mtn Stick. The same shuffle motion, but he goes to the flat. They get depth, throw it right away.
Mtn Corner Y-Drag. The motion puts him in a stack, so he gets a free release and breaks to the outside.

formations.name: Trips TE
formations.desc: The orbit formation. Three plays use the same orbit motion, so they see him come around over and over: the screen to McCaffrey, the wheel behind it and the RPO. Deep In is the one play touchdown out of it.
bullets: McCaffrey on the screen or the wheel
Deep In bombs Cover 3 and Cover 2

show.what: Orbit Cross Screen. Everybody follows the orbit and we sneak McCaffrey out with three blockers in front.
Orbit PA HB Wheel. The same orbit, but now he gets vertical. Wait until he clears the flat defender.
Deep In. The running back streak holds the safety in the middle and the post gets up and over to the short side. Let it fly.

sections.label: FORMATIONS
sections.info: Your core looks at a glance. If a look is not up here, you do not line up in it today.

sections.label: X-FACTOR
sections.info: We want to use Christian McCaffrey in this scheme a lot. Pick the call that feeds your best player.

sections.label: RUN GAME
sections.info: Always start with the run and get a gauge on what they are in. Zone, trap and toss.

sections.label: PASS CONCEPTS
sections.info: The dropback menu and the play action off the runs you already set up.

sections.label: BEAT MAN
sections.info: When he switches to man, go to the man beaters.

sections.label: BEAT ZONE
sections.info: Pull the deep defenders back, then drop it in behind the flat.

sections.label: ONE-PLAY TDs
sections.info: One play touchdowns. Know them cold.

sections.label: 3RD & LONG
sections.info: Get it up over the flat defenders, or take the curl when everybody plays way back.

sections.label: RED ZONE
sections.info: The RPOs walk it in up the middle and the toss gets to the edge.

sections.label: CONSTRAINT PAIRS
sections.info: A constraint play punishes the defense for overplaying your base play. Run one to set up the other.

pairs.note: it looks the exact same: they come down on the trap, it goes over their heads
fake the run off the motion and boot out the opposite way

pillars.name: Base Offense
pillars.line: We always start with the run to get a gauge on what they are in. The motion on the zone buys us an extra blocker, the trap gets downhill right up the middle with more beef on the field, and the play action off both runs starts the exact same, so the linebackers bite down and the routes get in behind them.

checks: Nobody comes over with the motion and the zone has an extra blocker on the play side
The run is picking up yards and they start loading the box to stop it
The linebackers bite down on the fake, the flat defender stays shallow and the corner route gets up over his head along the sideline

pillars.name: McCaffrey Pass Game
pillars.line: Now we get Christian McCaffrey into the pass game, building right off the base offense. The motion gets him out of the backfield fast on the wheel, the orbit is eye candy that pulls the linebackers one way while the screen goes back the other, and the same orbit lets him go vertical.

checks: The wheel pulls the flat defender back and the drag is wide open underneath
The linebackers follow the orbit and McCaffrey has blockers out in front
The user leaves with the orbit and McCaffrey squirts out with nobody on him

pillars.name: Explosive Pass Game
pillars.line: These are our shots down the field. Mtn Corner Y-Drag beats man four different ways and we can set it up for man or zone, and Deep In is a one play touchdown that can bomb Cover 3 and Cover 2.

checks: They switch to man and the corner route breaks away with a free release
They mix up man and zone and the same setup still has an answer
The running back streak holds the middle safety and the post gets up and over to the short side

pillars.name: Scheme Kings
pillars.line: Everything else we run out of the same four formations, all exclusive to Scheme Kings. The RPOs take whatever numbers they give us, the toss turns the corner when they squeeze inside, Mtn Stick moves the chains, Mtn PA Boot Rt is a second man beater, Mesh layers the wheel, the drag, the sit and the Z post, and the cheat motion gives us a two play mini scheme.

checks: They take away the inside run and the RPO has the numbers outside
Everyone squeezes inside and the toss gets around the edge
They commit to the jailbreak screen and the tight end is left unguarded

home.pitch: The zone, the trap and the toss, the play action right off of them, and Christian McCaffrey all over the pass game. All of it out of the Los Angeles Rams playbook.

book.note: every formation and every call on the sheet lives inside it

plays.name: Mtn HB Zone Wk

reads.label: The Auto Motion
reads.text: I really love this auto motion that comes across. We have pass plays in this formation that use motion too, so it can help disguise what we are doing.

reads.label: The Extra Blocker
reads.text: If it is zone coverage or match coverage, they are not going to bring an extra guy over. We just bought an extra blocker on this side of the football, and he can come pick off the safety when we get up the field.

reads.label: The Outside Heel
reads.text: With these outside zone runs I am aiming for about the outside heel of the offensive lineman, then I am just reading it. Am I able to bounce it, or do I bend it back? There is no set rule.

reads.label: Cut It Back
reads.text: See the hole, cut it back and we are gone. Once you get to the second level it is about making people miss, putting your foot in the ground and running super decisively.

reads.label: Against Man
reads.text: If it is man coverage they bring another defender over. We do not gain anything, but we do not lose anything either. It is even numbers on this side, we get a double team, and the run still works.

adjustments: Usually trips to the short side, so the motion goes to the wide side. It does not totally matter
plays.whenToUse: I always want to start with the run, just to get a gauge on what they are in. Against zone the motion buys an extra blocker, and against man it costs us nothing. It went 70 yards on the first snap of game one.

plays.name: Jet PA Sprint RT

reads.label: Hold the User
reads.text: The motion comes across, we fake the run, and we boot out the opposite way. That motion can help pull users and linebackers out of the box. He stops his feet, he does not know: go with the motion or bite down on the run.

reads.label: The Corner Route
reads.text: The streak pulls everyone back and the rollout gets us out on the perimeter. If the flat defender stays shallow, throw the corner route up over his head along the sideline. They have to get to about 20 yards to take it away.

reads.label: The Running Back in the Flat
reads.text: If the flat defender plays back at 15 to 20 yards and nobody is down underneath on the running back, drop it down to him as you roll out. Let him make plays in the open field.

reads.label: The Deep Crosser
reads.text: If they take away the corner and somebody is down on the running back, the third read is the deep crosser coming across into that hole. Set your feet and fire it in.

adjustments: Trips to the wide side of the field
Outside receiver on the trips side on a streak
Tight end on a corner route
plays.whenToUse: A nice one, two, three read play action off of our really good run play. Set it up with the zone, get the motion across, and boot out the other way.

plays.name: 0 1 Trap

reads.label: More Beef on the Field
reads.text: Very, very good downhill, quick hitting run play. We have extra tight ends on the field in Wing Slot Offset, so we have more beef on the field.

reads.label: Let the D Tackle Through
reads.text: We pick a player, usually the D tackle, and allow him to get up field. That lets two offensive linemen peel up right away and start picking off linebackers.

reads.label: The Guard Traps Him
reads.text: The guard comes through and kicks out the player we let up the field before he can get to the running back. That opens a massive lane in the middle of the field.

reads.label: Right Up the Middle
reads.text: It hits super fast, right up the middle. Put your foot in the ground and make a safety miss in the open field.

plays.whenToUse: I love traps in general because they hit super fast. It sets up PA Read out of the same look.

plays.name: PA Read

reads.label: The Tight End Corner
reads.text: Hard play action holds the linebackers down. The streak pulls the deep defender back, the flat stops at ten or eleven yards, and the tight end corner route gets up along the sideline.

reads.label: The Seam Against Single High
reads.text: Against a single high look, the outside corner cannot commit too far inside because he has the tight end corner route. If the linebackers bite down, wait and throw it right down the seam over their heads.

reads.label: The Shallow In Cut
reads.text: If they bite on the play action, look at the shallow cut. The user sees play action, then has to get out and back over the top, and by then it is too late.

reads.label: Against Man
reads.text: Our two best options versus man are the shallow in cut and the deeper cut. It is just how much time we have.

reads.label: The Deeper Post
reads.text: Against zone, if the corner and the shallow cross are taken away, the deep defenders get run off and the deeper post comes in front of them, behind the linebackers.

adjustments: Two receiver side to the wide side of the field
Inside tight end on a streak
plays.whenToUse: It works great off the 0 1 Trap because it looks the exact same. Once you mix it up they cannot come down as hard on the trap, so it all works hand in hand.

plays.name: Mtn Mills

reads.label: Wait for the Wheel
reads.text: The go to route is the wheel out of the backfield. The motion lets him get out of the box faster. Against zone the streak pulls them back, so wait until we clear in behind the flat and drop it in up the sideline.

reads.label: The Wheel Against Man
reads.text: I do not call this as a man beater, but if they call man on you the linebacker gets caught inside and you can quick throw it. If it is one on one and you have a step, buy time and let McCaffrey high point it.

reads.label: The Drag
reads.text: If the flat defender gets way underneath your wheel and everybody is playing back under the vertical routes, the drag comes across just in behind the wheel. Put it in his hands for seven or eight yards.

reads.label: The Dig
reads.text: The drag pulls guys down and the dig breaks in. If the middle of the field is open, throw that dig.

reads.label: The Deeper Post
reads.text: We have three layers in the middle of the field. The user vacates, the drag comes down, the dig comes in, and the post comes up over the top. No middle players: let it fly.

adjustments: Trips to the wide side of the field
Tight end on a streak
Outside receiver on the wide side on a post
plays.whenToUse: This is where we get McCaffrey involved in the pass game, and it is one of my favorite plays in the whole scheme. Really good versus basically any zone and versus match. Not a great call versus man.

plays.name: Orbit Cross Screen

reads.label: The Eye Candy
reads.text: The orbit is the eye candy. The flow of the offense goes with it, so guys leave the box and the middle of the field to follow the orbit.

reads.label: McCaffrey on the Screen
reads.text: Then we sneak McCaffrey out to the trips side with three blockers out in front. Use those blocks, get up field, and pick up the yards that are there.

reads.label: The Deep Crosser
reads.text: If the linebackers run with the screen or run with the orbit, they are not in the middle of the field. Fire in the deep crosser where he replaces them.

reads.label: If They Call Man
reads.text: Screens are not great against man. If the orbit man defender gets stuck inside you can throw the orbit, or look to the deep crosser and the tight end dig.

adjustments: Trips to the wide side of the field
plays.whenToUse: Get McCaffrey out in space with blockers in front. Use it with the other two orbit plays so they start paying attention to the orbit. It can be great against zone blitzes.

plays.name: Orbit PA HB Wheel

reads.label: The Wheel
reads.text: The go to route after the play action. The streak from the slot pulls back the deep defenders, the running back wheels up along the sideline, and after he clears the flat defender we drop it in vertically.

reads.label: The Eye Candy Against Man
reads.text: I would not call it versus man, but if they call it, the orbit and the play action make it really hard for the user to stay disciplined. The running back squirts out and there is nobody on him.

reads.label: The Deep Crosser
reads.text: If there is no time for the wheel or the linebackers stay shallow, both streaks pull everyone back and we hit the deep crosser up over the top.

reads.label: The Orbit Checkdown
reads.text: If everyone is playing back, or it is man and the running back does not come open, the checkdown is the orbit motion into the opposite flat.

adjustments: Trips to the wide side of the field
Middle player on the trips side on a streak
Outside player on the trips side on a deep cross
Tight end on a streak
plays.whenToUse: The same orbit as the screen, but now the running back gets vertical. This is when you take a shot down the field and use McCaffrey as a vertical weapon.

plays.name: Mtn Corner Y-Drag

reads.label: The Corner Route
reads.text: It all starts with the auto motion down from the outside receiver. He comes into the stack so they cannot press him, gets a free release one on one, puts his foot in the ground and breaks to the outside.

reads.label: The Quick Out
reads.text: If the corner does not get separation, look down to the little delay quick out. If it is off coverage or the defender gets caught inside, throw it up along the sideline.

reads.label: The Post When the Middle Is Open
reads.text: Then work inside to the slot on the post whenever the middle of the field is open. If the user rushes or the linebackers blitz, or the safety runs down on the tight end drag, there is no safety help and it is one on one in the middle of the field. If the safety is playing too deep, the post cuts in front of him. Fire it in and run away from the defender.

reads.label: The Drag
reads.text: Let everything develop down the field, and the tight end drag is the checkdown as he comes across. That makes four ways to beat man.

reads.label: Man or Zone
reads.text: If you are unsure, put the out route on a streak. He runs off the deep defenders, the corner route gets up the sideline against zone, and the tight end sits down. Against man you still have the corner, the post and the drag.

adjustments: Trips to the wide side of the field
Inside slot receiver on a post
Block your running back
Not sure if it is man or zone: put the slot on the out route on a streak
plays.whenToUse: Our go to man beater, absolute nails in game one. It has four ways to beat man, and with one hot route it attacks man or zone, no matter what they call.

plays.name: Deep In

reads.label: Bomb Cover 3
reads.text: The safety goes to the deep middle and the running back streak holds him there. The tight end corner holds down the deep outside defender, so wait until the post gets up and over to the short side and let it fly.

reads.label: Bomb Cover 2
reads.text: If they do not have a middle read riding the post, the tight end pulls the short side deep defender out and the running back vertical helps hold the other one. Split the two safeties up the middle with the post.

reads.label: The Curl
reads.text: If everybody is playing way off, like a third and 15, do not force the ball down the field. Just throw the curl route.

reads.label: The Dig
reads.text: The other checkdown is the dig over the top of the curl, when multiple players are playing over the deep routes.

adjustments: Trips to the wide side of the field
Motion your running back over and put him on a streak
Leave the slot receiver on the curl
plays.whenToUse: A really nice one play touchdown that can bomb Cover 3 and can bomb Cover 2. When they play way back, take the curl.

plays.name: Orbit RPO Zone Alert

reads.label: Throw the Orbit
reads.text: If it is man coverage and the orbit defender gets caught inside, he has to come all the way across the field through the whole mess in the middle. Throw the orbit and get to the perimeter.

reads.label: Run It Up the Middle
reads.text: The screen forces guys to the wide side and the orbit holds guys to the short side, which gives us a ton more running room up the middle. We use it on the goal line and walk in.

reads.label: The Screen
reads.text: If at the snap the defense squeezes down because of the orbit and the defender stays inside, it is a two on one on the outside. Drop it out and let the blocker get in front.

adjustments: Trips to the wide side of the field
plays.whenToUse: The third play using the orbit motion. It pulls everyone into the box, so we get the ball on the perimeter, run it inside if they go out too far, or hit the orbit.

plays.name: RPO Zone Alert Omaha

reads.label: Count the Bubble
reads.text: My eyes are looking to the bubble right away at the snap. We count the defenders outside. If one or both jump inside at the snap it is three on two, so throw the bubble.

reads.label: Beat the End to the Edge
reads.text: A defensive end trying to get out there in a trail position still makes it three on two. Both blockers block out on the perimeter, beat him to the edge and turn up field.

reads.label: Hand It Off
reads.text: If they are playing the bubble and we do not have the numbers outside, we have the numbers advantage up the middle. Put your foot in the ground and run it right up the middle.

adjustments: Trips to the wide side of the field
plays.whenToUse: Use it when they have multiple safeties back. I never really go to the out route. I am really just using the run and the bubble screen.

plays.name: Mtn Stick

reads.label: The Running Back in the Flat
reads.text: Pick a side before the snap, and I usually work the short side first. If the linebackers get depth and play underneath the tight end corner, throw the running back in the flat right away for seven, eight, nine yards.

reads.label: The Corner Over the Hard Flat
reads.text: If the flat defender jumps down on the running back, wait for the tight end to get up over the top, especially against a Cover 2 look. We are high lowing that flat defender.

reads.label: The Corner Against Man
reads.text: If we see man on this side, the running back can separate, or as the tight end breaks on the corner route, throw the tight end corner.

reads.label: The Stick
reads.text: On the wide side it is a stick concept. The stick is an option route: versus zone he sits down, versus man he options out to the sideline.

reads.label: The Out Route
reads.text: The comeback makes the flat defender sink underneath it and the out route gets wide open along the sideline. If they play a hard flat, the comeback can come open over his head.

adjustments: Trips to the wide side of the field
Outside receiver on the wide side on a comeback
Tight end on a corner route
plays.whenToUse: The same shuffle motion as Mtn Mills, but the running back goes to the flat instead of wheeling. Mills is the deep shot, this is the quick chain mover.

plays.name: Jet PA Slot Screen

reads.label: The Jet Screen
reads.text: The jet motion goes, they think he is not getting the ball, then he hooks up. The play action pulls guys down, two linemen pull out in front, and we throw the screen to the jet motion player.

reads.label: The Deep Over
reads.text: If they overload the screen side, work away from it after the play action. When the deep over route has a step on his man, throw it in.

reads.label: The Running Back in the Flat
reads.text: If everybody gets back away from the screen side, the running back goes into the flat after the play action. Drop it in to him for the easy first down.

adjustments: Three receiver side to the wide side of the field
plays.whenToUse: A really unique look off the jet motion. The motion always comes across, so they do not know what we are going to do out of it. The screen is always the first look.

plays.name: Mtn PA Boot Rt

reads.label: The Corner Route
reads.text: Look to the wide side first. The motion player leaves and the drag goes across, so there is nothing over there: a one on one with the corner route. Separation off the break, fire it in.

reads.label: The Shallow Cross
reads.text: No separation on the corner, work inside. Scan the corner, scan the middle, scan behind. The shallower cross gets a step, fire it in.

reads.label: The Deeper Post
reads.text: If the shallower cross is taken away we have the deeper post. He breaks inside with separation, so throw it in front of the safety.

reads.label: The Drag
reads.text: The last option is the tight end drag. If everything down the field is covered it is the checkdown, and if they bring a blitz it is your hot.

adjustments: Trips to the wide side of the field
Middle player on the wide side on a corner route
Block your running back
Tight end on a drag
plays.whenToUse: A really good man beating play: four man beating routes, plus the running back blocking in case they bring pressure. The motion looks like our runs and our screens.

plays.name: Mesh

reads.label: The Wheel
reads.text: The streak pulls the deep defenders back. If the flat stays shallow, throw the running back as soon as the wheel clears up over his head. If everybody drops way back, throw it underneath them and let him make a play.

reads.label: The Drag
reads.text: If everybody gets way underneath the wheel and is playing back, throw the drag coming across. It is also your hot versus the blitz.

reads.label: The Tight End Sit
reads.text: If the user drives on the drag and the linebackers bite down, the tight end sit route settles in the middle of the field. This play does a great job of layering the concepts.

reads.label: The Z Post
reads.text: The streak pulls back the deep players and the drag and the sit take the linebackers. If the safeties turn their backs, the Z post comes in behind them for about 30 yards down the middle.

adjustments: Trips to the short side of the field
Running back on a wheel, it goes to the wide side from the hash
Solo receiver on a streak
plays.whenToUse: One of my favorite plays in the scheme. It is not a true mesh even though it is called Mesh: the wheel for McCaffrey, the post getting vertical and two options underneath.

plays.name: Z Close Toss

reads.label: Power, Not Just Zone
reads.text: What makes the 49ers so good in real life in the run game is how diverse it is. They do not just run zone, they run power run plays as well. That means pullers: down blocking, then pulling out.

reads.label: The Same Side Run
reads.text: Out of the gun people are not thinking toss and they are not thinking same side run. It goes away from what most people are used to seeing out of a shotgun run.

reads.label: Pin Them Inside
reads.text: Two tight ends and the Z receiver in line condense the formation, so they condense down. When we toss it outside it is much easier to pin everyone inside and turn the corner.

reads.label: Use the Pullers
reads.text: The pullers get out on the edge. Use the block, set it up one on one with the safety, make him miss and turn it up the field.

plays.whenToUse: The power side of a diverse run game. If they squeeze inside, bring blitzes or crash the middle, get it out to the edge.

plays.name: Cheat HB Jailbreak Screen

reads.label: Five Blockers Out in Front
reads.text: Cheat motion the running back to the wide side and you get five blockers out in front. It is a little two play mini scheme with Cheat Ohio TE Attack.

reads.label: Throw It Quick
reads.text: It is a swing, but if you wait too long he hooks up like a screen. Throw it while he still has speed leaving the box. Give the linemen time to get out, but not enough for the defensive line to follow them.

reads.label: The Backside Tight End
reads.text: If everybody commits to the running back and leaves the tight end unguarded, look backside to the tight end out route and make a guy miss in the open field.

adjustments: Tight ends to the short side of the field
plays.whenToUse: Run it a few times and get the user and the linebackers firing out of the box on the motion. Then go to Cheat Ohio TE Attack.

plays.name: Cheat Ohio TE Attack

reads.label: The Corner Route
reads.text: After a few jailbreak screens people start overplaying the motion, so we have all the time in the world. The streak runs the deep defender off and the corner route gets up over the top along the sideline.

reads.label: The Inside Tight End
reads.text: Against man he can break inside with nice separation. Against zone, if the linebackers leave to take the swing or the corner, look to the inside tight end as he breaks through.

reads.label: The Deeper Tight End
reads.text: The safety flips his hips and the linebacker stays shallow on the inside tight end. The outside tight end breaks to the post, so throw it up over the first tight end, with the safeties out of position.

reads.label: The Swing
reads.text: If the user takes away the tight ends and nothing is open down the field, check it down to the running back in the flat and let him pick up four or five yards or more.

adjustments: Tight ends to the short side of the field
Middle slot receiver on a corner route
Make sure the outside receiver is on a streak
plays.whenToUse: The shot off the jailbreak screen, the same cheat motion. The user and linebackers leave with the swing and we attack behind them.
